verdict.rationale: A probe confirms Stripe documents an official CLI at docs.stripe.com/stripe-cli, which Identity users can use as part of the Stripe API surface. However, no evidence shows Identity-specific CLI commands, such as creating or inspecting verification sessions; the docs show curl against the API instead. Missing for 10: evidence that the CLI covers Identity resources, CLI command documentation for verification sessions, and hands-on or independent corroboration of AI-native CLI workflows.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can use an official CLI
